title: Permission ledger offramp: staged dual-write safeguards and audit handoff
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: retire the legacy permission ledger (RBAC v1 authoritative store) with a phased off-ramp that preserves audit fidelity, SSO role mappings, and admin controls. This ticket owns the staged dual-write window, the reconciliation and snapshot procedures, automated abort/rollback triggers, and the customer comms cadence for opt-in/opt-out waves.

Scope: dual-write orchestration, backfill reconciliation jobs, sampled validation, audit export/attach policy, admin UX for migration status, and runbook for emergency rollback. Does NOT include schema design of the v2 role model (handled by ENG-21634) or SAML identity provider changes (handled in ENG-8347).

Non-goals: ad-hoc customer-specific transformation scripts (handled by solutions-eng) and data-migration tooling for on-prem customers (separate private-deploy run).
acceptance_criteria: Dual-write mode available in production via Concord migration-orchestrator with safe flags and feature gate
Backfill jobs completed for 95% of orgs in first two waves with reconciliation drift < 0.1%
Audit log continuity: append-only export available for cross-checks and can be attached to support tickets
Admin console shows per-org migration state and a one-click opt-out for first 30 days
Automated rollback can be executed within 10 minutes with documented fallout and customer comms template
tasks: Add safe dual-write headers and idempotency keys to write path (ENG runtime team)
Implement reconciliation job 'concord-audit' with sampling and quorum checks
Implement nightly snapshot exporter for append-only audit retrievals
Build admin console migration view with opt-out and last-successful-sync timestamp
Create automatic abort thresholds and SLO alarms in Sentra for divergence > 1%
Draft customer comms templates and wave schedule for GA customers
rollback_plan: If divergence exceeds hard threshold or a critical user-facing regression is detected, flip Concord orchestrator to read-only on v2 writes and route all writes back to v1 for affected orgs. Run a fast backfill sanity check on v2 to identify incomplete writes, notify customers using the pre-approved template, and schedule a controlled re-run after root cause remediation. All rollback steps documented in runbook link below.
